'''Luis Emilio Blanco Coto''' (born 15 January 1990) is an Andorran [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[midfielder]] for [[CF Esperança d'Andorra|Esperança]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].<ref name="WF">{{LaPreferente}}</ref>

==Career==
Blanco made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] on 6 September 2020 in the [[2020–21 UEFA Nations League D|UEFA Nations League]] against the [[Faroe Islands national football team|Faroe Islands]], which finished as a 0–1 home loss.<ref name="EUF">{{cite web |url=https://eu-football.info/_player.php?id=31004 |title=Luis Blanco |website=EU-Football.info |access-date=6 September 2020}}</ref>
